name: rsync
description: Compact rsync output — short-circuit successful syncs to a summary, strip progress lines.

tests.name: successful-sync-short-circuits
tests.input:
sending incremental file list
file1.txt
file2.txt

sent 1,234 bytes  received 42 bytes  2,552.00 bytes/sec
total size is 98,765  speedup is 77.31

tests.name: error-lines-pass-through
tests.input:
sending incremental file list
rsync: [Receiver] mkdir "/remote/path" failed: Permission denied (13)
rsync error: error in file system (code 11) at receiver.c(741) [Receiver=3.2.7]
tests.expected:
rsync: [Receiver] mkdir "/remote/path" failed: Permission denied (13)
rsync error: error in file system (code 11) at receiver.c(741) [Receiver=3.2.7]
